summary: Wrote src/en/module_03/12-concepts-c.md: s11 Detection (1,371 words / target 1,200), s12 Segmentation (1,311 / 1,150), s13 Signals and volumes (1,433 / 1,250), s14 Looking inside (1,162 / 1,050), all within +15%; concept total 5,277 against about 4,650 (+13.5%), each section near the top of its band. Then 'What goes wrong' (about 960 words, 14 symptom/cause/fix entries under five ### groups). Every must_cover item, worked example (as ::: worked with the arithmetic), planned figure (fig-03-26 to fig-03-38, captions matching the plan's descriptions) and check/answer pair from the slice is included. A keyidea closes each section. The source's Down3D block is reformatted to 88-character lines, with its parameter count (28704) printed. All closed-form numbers were recomputed with labpy.sh: IoU, NMS, anchor offsets, focal loss, AP, the U-Net size trace, transposed-convolution sizes and overlap counts, Dice/IoU and the soft-Dice gradient, WaveNet receptive fields, 3D parameter counts, activation memory, group-norm counts, the disc, sphere and ellipsoid measurements, and marching cubes via a scratch install of scikit-image. Lab 5 and Lab 6 numbers are taken from the plan and quoted as lab measurements. check.mjs reports 0 errors in this file.
changes: s13 ellipsoid, marching cubes on the binary mask: recomputed at placements that give 6,372 voxels as 1,315-1,316 um^2 (+21%), not 1,317 (+22%); after the 0.5 um blur, 1,137 (+5%), not 1,136. The text uses the recomputed values.

s13 ellipsoid, spread over 20 random sub-voxel placements: my draw (default_rng(0), offsets in voxel units) gives a mean of 3,169.1 and a standard deviation of 30.0 (30.8 with ddof=1), against the plan's 3,169.6 and 29.5. The text says 'about 3,170 (bias +0.1%)' and 'about 30 (1%)'. The exposed-face area at a 6,372-voxel placement is 1,607.5-1,614 (the plan says 1,610); the text says 'about 1,610'.

s13 ideal shapes: the plan's disc and sphere numbers reproduce only at particular sub-pixel offsets: disc centre at (0.3, 0.3) px; sphere at (0.2, 0.2, 0.2). The blurred-disc perimeter of 50.2 needs Gaussian sigma = 0.9 px (sigma 1 gives 50.06), so the text says 'blurred by a Gaussian of 0.9 pixels' instead of 'slightly blurred'.

s11 additions derived from the plan's numbers: the aggregate focal-loss example (19,900 easy negatives give 200 of cross-entropy, as much as about 87 hard examples, but 0.020 of focal loss), and the VOC 2007 11-point AP for the five-detection example (0.682, against all-point 0.6875).
s11: added Faster R-CNN's anchor-labelling rule (positive at IoU >= 0.7, negative below 0.3), then cut it for length. It is not in the published text.
issues: check.mjs reports 2 ERRORs, both in another writer's file: src/en/module_03/21-labs-b.md line 1356 has '$<BEL>lpha_k^c$'. The backslash of 'lpha' became a control character, probably through a shell escaping step. That writer's file needs fixing; this one is clean.

Lab 5 numbers (Dice and IoU, boundary accuracy, the 221-circle measurement ratios) and Lab 6 numbers (accuracies, corner shares, 3e-10, the 0.10 correlation) are copied from the plan and could not be checked until those labs run.
Zech et al. (2018) is described without exact figures ('high accuracy', 'often did worse on hospitals not seen in training'), so as not to overstate the paper.
The figures in s14 appear in the order fig-03-38, then 36, then 37, because the first-layer-filter figure belongs to the opening subsection. In s11 and s13 the figures are in numeric order.
